characters.name: Pip
characters.image_alt: Pip, a small brown garden sparrow, standing side-on mid-hop with his head tilted, looking curious.
characters.species: a small brown garden sparrow with a quick, bobbing hop
characters.personality: Endlessly curious and quick to ask 'what's that?' — Pip notices everything first but rarely stops to think before hopping in.
characters.home: A twiggy nest tucked in the ivy above the garden shed, with the best view of the whole garden.

characters.name: Ned
characters.image_alt: Ned, a fluffy yellow-brown duckling, standing side-on with his wings a little out for balance, looking cheeky.
characters.species: a fluffy yellow-brown duckling still learning to swim in a straight line
characters.personality: Cheeky and a bit of a prankster — Ned loves a good splash and can never resist one more wobbly dare.
characters.home: A nest of flattened reeds at the edge of the round pond, right where the water laps in.

characters.name: Olive
characters.image_alt: Olive, a round grey owl with big amber eyes, perched facing the reader, looking sure of herself.
characters.species: a round, soft grey owl with big amber eyes and very firm opinions
characters.personality: Bossy but well-meaning — Olive is sure she knows the best way to do everything and isn't shy about saying so.
characters.home: A snug hollow in the old oak tree, high enough to keep an eye on the whole garden below.

characters.name: Moss
characters.image_alt: Moss, a small brown hedgehog with a snuffly nose, side-on and half-curled, looking shy but friendly.
characters.species: a small hedgehog with a snuffly nose and a coat of soft brown spikes
characters.personality: Shy and easily startled — Moss curls up small around new friends but is warm and loyal once he trusts you.
characters.home: A cosy pile of dry leaves tucked under the wooden garden bench.

characters.name: Fig
characters.image_alt: Fig, a stripy green caterpillar, side-on on a leaf with his head raised, looking careful.
characters.species: a stripy green caterpillar slowly getting ready to become a butterfly
characters.personality: A careful worrier who double-checks everything twice — Fig likes a plan and finds surprises a little wobbly.
characters.home: The cool underside of a cabbage leaf in the vegetable patch.

characters.name: Nell
characters.image_alt: Nell, a fuzzy striped bumblebee, in flight facing the reader with her wings blurred, looking busy.
characters.species: a fuzzy striped bumblebee who never seems to stop moving
characters.personality: Busy, kind and always in a hurry — Nell loves helping but sometimes needs reminding to slow down and listen.
characters.home: A hive tucked behind the tall sunflowers at the edge of the meadow patch.
